parameters.name: gX
parameters.description: U(1)_X gauge coupling in -1/(4 gX^2)|F_X|^2, Eq.(39)

parameters.name: c1
parameters.description: D'Hoker-Farhi coefficient c1, Eq.(48); UV anomaly-fixed value kappa=6, Eqs.(91),(95)

parameters.name: c2
parameters.description: D'Hoker-Farhi coefficient c2, Eq.(48); benchmark c1=c2=1, Figs.(lep,lhcsigma)

parameters.name: kappa
parameters.description: Chern-Simons coefficient kappa = 6, Eqs.(91),(95); equals c1 in the low-energy basis (terms use c1)

parameters.name: VevPhiX
parameters.description: Heavy Higgs VEV V [GeV], Eq.(61); heavy-fermion masses M=F*V realized here as explicit Mass values ~10 TeV, Sec.III

parameters.name: f1
parameters.description: SM-Higgs Yukawa f1, Eq.(60); m1 = f1*v << M1, Eq.(70)

parameters.name: F1
parameters.description: Heavy-Higgs Yukawa F1, Eq.(60); M1 = F1*V ~ 10 TeV

parameters.name: F2
parameters.description: Heavy-Higgs Yukawa F2, Eq.(60); M2 = F2*V ~ 10 TeV

parameters.name: Mmix1
parameters.description: psi1-chi1 off-diagonal Dirac mass from F1,Ftilde1 VEVs, Eqs.(60),(62)

parameters.name: m1df
parameters.description: Dirac mass m1 = f1*v for the psi1 sector, Eq.(70)

parameters.name: th1
parameters.description: psi1-chi1 mixing angle diagonalising [[m1,Mmix1],[Mmix1,0]], Eq.(62); eigenvalues M+-m1/2

parameters.name: th2
parameters.description: psi2-chi2 maximal mixing angle: [[0,M2],[M2,0]] gives degenerate eigenstates M2, Sec.III (kappa!=0 condition)

particles.full_name: Stueckelberg field theta_X (phase of Phi, eaten by X), Eq.(39)
Heavy Higgs Phi (SU(2)xY singlet, Q_X=1, <Phi>=V), Eqs.(61),(69)
Heavy fermion mass eigenstate (Q=-3/4, mass M1+m1/2), Eq.(62)
Heavy fermion mass eigenstate (Q=-3/4, mass M1-m1/2), Eq.(62)
Heavy fermion (Q=1/4, up components of psi1L and chi1R), Table VI
Heavy fermion (Q=1/12, degenerate M2, psi2/chi2 sector), Sec.III
Heavy fermion (Q=1/12, degenerate M2, psi2/chi2 sector), Sec.III
Heavy fermion (Q=13/12, up components of psi2R and chi2L), Table VI

definitions: Psi1L[sp_, 2] :> Module[{sp2}, ProjM[sp, sp2] (Cos[th1] Fdm1[sp2] - Sin[th1] Fdm2[sp2])]
Psi1R[sp_] :> Module[{sp2}, ProjP[sp, sp2] (Cos[th1] Fdm1[sp2] - Sin[th1] Fdm2[sp2])]
Chi1L[sp_] :> Module[{sp2}, ProjM[sp, sp2] (Sin[th1] Fdm1[sp2] + Cos[th1] Fdm2[sp2])]
Chi1R[sp_, 2] :> Module[{sp2}, ProjP[sp, sp2] (Sin[th1] Fdm1[sp2] + Cos[th1] Fdm2[sp2])]

lagrangian_terms.name: LXkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu, nu}, -1/(4 gX^2) (del[X[nu], mu] - del[X[mu], nu])^2 + MX^2/2 (del[thX, mu] + X[mu])^2]

lagrangian_terms.name: LPhikin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, DC[PhiXbar, mu] DC[PhiX, mu] - Mphi^2 PhiXbar PhiX]

lagrangian_terms.name: LPsi1Lkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, ExpandIndices[I Psi1Lbar.Ga[mu].DC[Psi1L, mu], FlavorExpand -> SU2D]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LPsi1Rkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, I Psi1Rbar.Ga[mu].DC[Psi1R, mu]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LPsi2Lkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, I Psi2Lbar.Ga[mu].DC[Psi2L, mu]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LPsi2Rkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, ExpandIndices[I Psi2Rbar.Ga[mu].DC[Psi2R, mu], FlavorExpand -> SU2D]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LChi1Lkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, I Chi1Lbar.Ga[mu].DC[Chi1L, mu]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LChi1Rkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, ExpandIndices[I Chi1Rbar.Ga[mu].DC[Chi1R, mu], FlavorExpand -> SU2D]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LChi2Lkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, ExpandIndices[I Chi2Lbar.Ga[mu].DC[Chi2L, mu], FlavorExpand -> SU2D]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LChi2Rkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, I Chi2Rbar.Ga[mu].DC[Chi2R, mu]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LFdm1mass
lagrangian_terms.expression: -Mfdm1 Fdm1bar.Fdm1

lagrangian_terms.name: LFdm2mass
lagrangian_terms.expression: -Mfdm2 Fdm2bar.Fdm2

lagrangian_terms.name: LFup1mass
lagrangian_terms.expression: -Mfup1 Fup1bar.Fup1

lagrangian_terms.name: LFdn3mass
lagrangian_terms.expression: -Mfdn3 Fdn3bar.Fdn3

lagrangian_terms.name: LFdn4mass
lagrangian_terms.expression: -Mfdn4 Fdn4bar.Fdn4

lagrangian_terms.name: LFup2mass
lagrangian_terms.expression: -Mfup2 Fup2bar.Fup2

lagrangian_terms.name: LYf1
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{sp, ii}, f1 Psi1Lbar[sp, ii].Psi1R[sp] Phi[ii] + HC[f1 Psi1Lbar[sp, ii].Psi1R[sp] Phi[ii]]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LYF1
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{sp, ii}, F1 Psi1Lbar[sp, ii].Chi1R[sp, ii] PhiXbar + HC[F1 Psi1Lbar[sp, ii].Chi1R[sp, ii] PhiXbar]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LYF2
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{sp, ii}, F2 Psi2Rbar[sp, ii].Chi2L[sp, ii] PhiXbar + HC[F2 Psi2Rbar[sp, ii].Chi2L[sp, ii] PhiXbar]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LYFt1
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{sp}, Ft1 Psi1Rbar[sp].Chi1L[sp] PhiX + HC[Ft1 Psi1Rbar[sp].Chi1L[sp] PhiX]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LYFt2
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{sp}, Ft2 Psi2Lbar[sp].Chi2R[sp] PhiX + HC[Ft2 Psi2Lbar[sp].Chi2R[sp] PhiX]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LDH1
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu, nu, la, rho, ii, jj}, ExpandIndices[c1 Eps[mu, nu, la, rho] (Phibar[ii] DC[Phi[ii], mu])/(Phibar[jj] Phi[jj]) (del[thX, nu] + X[nu]) FS[B, la, rho], FlavorExpand -> {SU2D, SU2W}]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LDH2
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu, nu, la, rho, aa, bb, jj, ll}, ExpandIndices[c2 Eps[mu, nu, la, rho] DC[Phibar[aa], mu] PauliSigma[jj, aa, bb] FS[Wi, la, rho, jj] Phi[bb] (del[thX, nu] + X[nu])/(Phibar[ll] Phi[ll]), FlavorExpand -> {SU2D, SU2W}]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LTotal
lagrangian_terms.expression: LXkin + LPhikin + LPsi1Lkin + LPsi1Rkin + LPsi2Lkin + LPsi2Rkin + LChi1Lkin + LChi1Rkin + LChi2Lkin + LChi2Rkin + LFdm1mass + LFdm2mass + LFup1mass + LFdn3mass + LFdn4mass + LFup2mass + LYf1 + LYF1 + LYF2 + LYFt1 + LYFt2 + LDH1 + LDH2
